_comment: Project-level MCP config for Henri. Added 2026-04-22 to unblock the
wedge + FSM plan phases that need programmatic DB + outbound
delivery access. Each server below requires an env-sourced secret —
paste the matching key into .env.local (already gitignored) and
restart Claude Code; the server auto-activates.
Once live, these servers give Claude:
- supabase  → apply_migration, execute_sql, list_tables, RLS mgmt
- resend    → send feedback/outreach/invoice emails from templates
- stripe    → read subscription state, refund flows (rare)
- playwright→ deterministic browser automation for contractor-side QA
Secrets NEVER live here. .mcp.json IS committed to git (project
shape is part of the repo), but every `env` line references a
process variable that the user sets outside the repo.
